top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs two achievements I can justify part by part. Crews and Deshaies conceived and first demonstrated heterobifunctional degraders, which turn ubiquitin-dependent proteolysis into a designable chemical operation, and the narrow citation is accurate without the contested Ciulli, Handa, Sakamoto and glue seats. Liu's base editing is the cleanest single-laureate case: an engineered and evolved deaminase on a programmable scaffold acts on DNA bases without double-strand cleavage, is used routinely in many labs, and has reached first patients. The principal risks are that no degrader is yet approved and the Nishida and Kondo priority question. P002 is next because it keeps the degrader concept and adds Handa's cereblon work, but it drops Liu and blurs design with after-the-fact mechanism. Liu alone follows, then C-N coupling with Liu, condensates, zeolites, and no award last.
